result.title: OpenSaC: A Python Library for Search as Code in Deep Research Agents
result.summary: Deep research agents investigate complex questions through iterative search, source examination, and evidence synthesis. A conventional workflow alternates reasoning with individual search and reading actions. Search as Code introduces a new paradigm: agents write programs that compose search, source reading, reranking, model calls, and local processing, returning selected observations for further reasoning. To support this workflow in existing coding agents, we present OpenSaC, an open-source Python library with a companion Search as Code skill. Configurable capability interfaces let agents combine these operations while retaining evidence for inspection and reuse. Compared with standard Codex using its built-in web search, the OpenSaC configuration uses less execution time and fewer model tokens on BrowseComp and WideSearch, with higher accuracy on BrowseComp and slightly lower row F1 on WideSearch. We aim to lower the barrier to adopting Search as Code and provide an open foundation for community development and transparent research on deep research agents.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 OpenSaC：一个开源 Python 库与配套「Search as Code」skill，让深度研究型 agent 通过编写程序组合搜索、源阅读、重排、模型调用与本地处理，并把选出的观察结果交回推理；在 BrowseComp 与 WideSearch 上与 Codex 内置网页搜索比较执行时间、token 消耗和准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文既无视觉/多模态成分也无 latent 状态，但与 LVR 中「获取证据、选择观察并复用」的推理流程有间接联系：其用程序显式组织检索、重排与局部处理并保留证据供检查复用的做法，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与外部证据获取策略提供可核查的类比，需较多转化工作。
